context_requirements: Active Hedgehog/GLI signaling, typically via SMO or downstream GLI activation
Expression of GLI1/GLI2 and Hedgehog target genes
Functional primary cilium for SMO-dependent inhibitors
falsifiers: No decrease in GLI2 or other Hedgehog target genes at 6 or 24 h in any line
No antiproliferative or cell-cycle transcriptional signature at 24 h
Strong and consistent upregulation of Hedgehog target genes across lines
No difference in response between lines with known Hedgehog activation and those without

evidence.supports: Vismodegib decreases GLI1 and survivin and reduces proliferation in BCC and HNSCC cells
Cyclopamine increases p27 and decreases IGF-II/Akt signaling in PC-3 prostate cancer cells
GDC-0449 reduces tumor growth and alters Shh pathway gene expression in mouse HCC
Hedgehog pathway inhibitors can induce caspase-8-dependent apoptosis in colon and pancreatic cancer cells
Pipinib inhibits PI4KB and suppresses GLI-mediated transcription and Hh target gene expression
